q: ‘Sky’ is to ‘bird’ as ‘water’ is to-
e: A bird moves through the sky, and a fish moves through water.

q: ‘Good’ is to ‘bad’ as ‘white’ is to-
e: Good and bad are opposites. The opposite of white is black.

q: ‘Botany’ is to ‘plants’ as ‘Zoology’ is to-
e: Botany is the study of plants, and zoology is the study of animals.

q: The bad news struck him like a bolt from the-
e: “A bolt from the blue” means a sudden, unexpected event, like lightning from a clear sky.

q: When one is ‘pragmatic’ he is being-
e: A pragmatic person deals with things in a practical, realistic way.

q: Into the ____ of death rode the six hundred.
e: The line is from Tennyson’s “The Charge of the Light Brigade”: “Into the valley of Death rode the six hundred.”

q: To be or not to be, that is the ____.
e: “To be, or not to be, that is the question” is Hamlet’s famous line in Shakespeare’s play “Hamlet”.

q: I have a ____ that one day this nation will live out the true meaning of its creed that all men are created equal.
e: The line is from Martin Luther King Jr.’s 1963 speech “I Have a Dream”.

q: Who wrote the two famous novels, ‘David Copperfield’ and ‘The Tale of two Cities’?
e: Charles Dickens wrote “David Copperfield” (1850) and “A Tale of Two Cities” (1859).

q: Who wrote the plays, ‘The Tempest’ and ‘The Mid Summer Night’s Dream’?
e: “The Tempest” and “A Midsummer Night’s Dream” are plays by William Shakespeare.

q: He had a _____ headache.
e: The natural English collocation is “a bad headache” (or “a severe headache”). “Strong” and “serious” are not normally used with headache.

q: A rocket flying to the moon does not need wings because-
e: Wings work by pushing against air. Space has no air, so a rocket flying to the moon uses its engine thrust instead of wings.

q: Rubber is notable for its-
e: Rubber is known for elasticity, the ability to stretch and come back to its shape.

q: Julius Caesar was the ruler of Rome about-
e: Julius Caesar ruled Rome in the first century BC. That was roughly 2000 years ago.

q: The South Pole is located in the-
e: The South Pole lies in Antarctica, the Antarctic region. The Arctic is around the North Pole.

q: Tiger : Zoology :: Mars : ?
e: Zoology is the science that studies animals such as the tiger. Likewise, astronomy is the science that studies planets such as Mars; astrology is not a science.

q: Frightened : Scream : : Angry : ?
e: A frightened person may scream, and an angry person may shout. Both pairs link a feeling to the loud sound it causes.

q: He ____ consciousness as a result of his head hitting the car’s dashboard.
e: The fixed expression is “lose consciousness”. Since the event is in the past, “lost” fits.

q: Only after I ____ home, did I remember my doctor’s appointment.
e: “Only after” at the start of a sentence brings inversion in the main clause (“did I remember”). The time clause keeps the simple past: “Only after I went home”.

q: When they had their first child, they put ____ a large sum for his education.
e: “Put aside” means to save money for a later purpose. So “they put aside a large sum” is correct.

q: Julia has been ill ____ three months.
e: “For” is used with a length of time, and “since” with a starting point. “Three months” is a length of time, so “for” fits.

q: We were waiting for the bus. The underlined part is-
e: “For the bus” starts with a preposition and has a noun as its object. So it is a prepositional phrase.

q: The word ‘disinterested’ means-
e: “Disinterested” means impartial or neutral, having no personal gain in a matter. It is different from “uninterested”, which means having no interest.

q: Who did write first English dictionary?
e: Samuel Johnson published “A Dictionary of the English Language” in 1755. It was the first widely accepted English dictionary.

q: New programs will be ____ next week in Bangladesh Television.
e: The past participle of “telecast” is “telecast”, like “cast”. So the correct form is “will be telecast”.

q: The word ‘electorate’ means-
e: The electorate is the whole body of people who have the right to vote in an election.

q: ‘Animal Farm’ was written by-
e: “Animal Farm” (1945) is a political fable by George Orwell. It attacks the abuse of power after the Russian Revolution.

q: There is no alternative ____ training.
e: The noun “alternative” takes the preposition “to”. So “no alternative to training” is correct.

q: Which sentence is correct?
o: This is a very unique case
This is the most unique case
e: “Unique” starts with a “yoo” sound, so it takes “a”, not “an”. Also, “unique” means one of a kind, so it does not take “very” or “most”.

q: I cannot ____ to pay such high prices.
e: “Afford” means to have enough money for something. “I cannot afford to pay such high prices” is the natural sentence.

q: Dhaka is becoming one of the ____ cities in Asia.
e: “One of the” is followed by a superlative and a plural noun. The superlative of “busy” is “busiest”; “most busiest” is a double superlative.

q: He had written the book before he-
e: When two past actions are compared, the earlier one takes the past perfect and the later one the simple past. Writing the book came first, so “before he retired” is correct.

q: Rizvi requested Rini ____ telephone to attend the meeting.
e: We say “by telephone” for the means of contact, as in “by post” or “by email”. “Over the telephone” is also used, but it needs “the”.

q: The word ‘precedence’ means-
e: “Precedence” means priority, the right to come first in order or importance.

q: The prices of rice are-
e: “Rise” is intransitive and means to go up. The present continuous “are rising” fits; “raise” needs an object.

q: ‘To get along with’ means-
e: “Get along with” means to have a friendly relationship or to adjust well with someone.

q: ‘If winter comes, can spring be far behind?’ These lines were written by-
e: The line is the last line of P. B. Shelley’s “Ode to the West Wind”. It expresses hope that bad times will be followed by good ones.

q: The verb of the word ‘short’ is-
e: Adding “-en” to “short” makes the verb “shorten”, which means to make shorter.

q: ‘light’ is to ‘dark’ as ‘cold’ is to-
e: Light and dark are opposites. The opposite of cold is hot.

q: Many prefer donating money ____ distributing clothes.
e: “Prefer” takes “to” when comparing two things: prefer A to B. So “prefer donating money to distributing clothes” is correct.

q: What would have happened if–?
e: This is a third conditional sentence: “would have happened” in the main clause needs the past perfect in the if-clause. So “if the bridge had broken” is correct.

q: Explain the meaning of ‘Bring to pass?
e: “Bring to pass” means to make something happen. So “cause to happen” is the correct meaning.

q: Which of the following sentences is the correct one?
e: We use “made from” when the raw material changes its form, as wood changes into paper. “Made of” is used when the material stays recognisable, like a table made of wood.

q: The word bounty is closest in meaning to?
e: “Bounty” means generous giving or a generous gift. So “generosity” is the closest meaning.

q: Give the correct passive form of ‘My teacher embodies all the good qualities’?
o: All the good qualities are embodied by my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied to my teacher.
All the good qualities are embodied on my teacher.
e: The verb “embody” takes the preposition “in” in the passive. So the correct form is “All the good qualities are embodied in my teacher.”

q: Choose the correct indirect speech—She asked me, ‘Are you happy in your new job?’
o: She asked me if I was happy in my new job
She asked me if I have been happy in my new job
She asked me whether I am happy in my new job
She asked me if I had been happy in my new job
e: In indirect speech, a yes/no question is introduced with “if” or “whether”, and the present tense shifts to the past. So “are you” becomes “I was”, and “your” becomes “my”.

q: The meaning of the word ‘obese’ is—?
e: “Obese” means very fat or seriously overweight. The other options have unrelated meanings.

q: A person who writes about his own life writes—?
e: A book a person writes about his own life is an autobiography. A biography is written by someone else.

q: Which of the following sentences is correct?
e: In a wh-question, the auxiliary comes before the subject: “Why have you done this?” The other options either keep statement order or mix tenses.

q: What will be the correct preposition to complete the sentence? ‘I am not good—translation’
e: We say “good at” a skill or activity. So the correct sentence is “I am not good at translation.”

q: Which is the noun of the word ‘beautiful’?
e: “Beauty” is the noun form. “Beautify” is a verb, “beauteous” an adjective, and “beautifully” an adverb.

q: Fill in the blank with appropriate perposition.’Hurry up! we have to go—five minutes.’
e: “In” before a period of time means “after that much time from now”. So “we have to go in five minutes” is correct.

q: Identify the imperative sentence.
o: It has been raining since morning
e: An imperative sentence gives an order or request, and its subject “you” is usually hidden. “Stand up” is such a sentence.

q: Fill in the gap with the suitable word : To stay healthy, we must plan to have a balanced—?
e: The fixed phrase is “a balanced diet”, meaning food with all the needed nutrients in the right amounts.

q: Choose the correct alternative and mark its letter on your answer sheet. The rich should not look down—the poor?
e: “Look down upon” (or “look down on”) means to regard someone as inferior. So “upon” fits the sentence.

q: I took a map with me, as I didn’t want to—my way on the journey?
e: “Lose” is a verb meaning to fail to find. “Loose” is an adjective meaning not tight, so “lose my way” is correct.

q: Every driver must be held—his own actions?
e: We are “responsible for” our actions and “responsible to” a person or authority. Here the object is “actions”, so “responsible for” fits.

q: Through thick and thin’ means?
e: “Through thick and thin” means under all conditions, in good times and bad.

q: ‘Prior to’ means—?
e: “Prior to” means before. For example, “prior to the meeting” means before the meeting.

q: Nobody knocked him down; it was an—?
e: An accident is an unexpected event that happens without anyone intending it. Since nobody knocked him down on purpose, “accident” fits best.

q: Choose the correct sentence.
e: ‘Everybody’ একবচন হিসেবে গণ্য হয়, তাই এর সঙ্গে singular verb ‘has’ বসে। ‘Go’-এর past participle ‘gone’, তাই ‘Everybody has gone there’ সঠিক।

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: The train is running in time
The train is running on time
The train is running with time
The train is running to time
e: নির্ধারিত সময়মতো চলা বোঝাতে ‘on time’ বলা হয়। ‘In time’ মানে সময় থাকতে বা দেরি হওয়ার আগে, যা ট্রেনের সময়সূচির ক্ষেত্রে মানায় না।

q: Choose the correct preposition. My brother has no interest_____music.
e: কোনো বিষয়ে আগ্রহ বোঝাতে ‘interest in’ বসে: ‘no interest in music’।

q: Fill in the blank with the right option. I am looking forward_____you.
e: ‘Look forward to’ phrase-এ ‘to’ একটি preposition, তাই এর পরে gerund বসে। তাই ‘looking forward to seeing you’ সঠিক।

q: Choose the correct from (passive) of__ `Who will do the work?’
o: Who will be done the work?
By whom will the work be done?
Whom will the work be done?
e: Interrogative বাক্যে ‘who’ দিয়ে কর্তা থাকলে passive-এ তা ‘by whom’ হয়ে শুরুতে বসে। ‘The work’ subject হয় এবং verb হয় ‘will be done’, তাই ‘By whom will the work be done?’।

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: I have looked for a good doctor before I met you.
I had looked for a good doctor before I met you.
I looked for a good doctor before I had met you.
I am looking for a good doctor before meeting you.
e: দুটি অতীত কাজের মধ্যে আগে ঘটা কাজ past perfect-এ এবং পরেরটি simple past-এ বসে। ডাক্তার খোঁজা আগে, আর তোমার সঙ্গে দেখা পরে, তাই ‘I had looked for... before I met you’।

q: Fill in the blank with correct preposition. He is devoid _____commonsense.
e: ‘Devoid’ শব্দের পরে সব সময় ‘of’ বসে, যার অর্থ কোনো কিছু থেকে বঞ্চিত বা শূন্য। যেমন ‘devoid of commonsense’।

q: Select the right word. He ran fast lest he_____miss the train.
e: ‘Lest’ মানে ‘যাতে না’, এবং এর পরে ‘should’ বসে। তাই ‘He ran fast lest he should miss the train’ সঠিক; ‘lest’-এর পরে আলাদা করে ‘not’ লাগে না।

q: The Arabian Nights_________still a great favourite.
e: ‘The Arabian Nights’ বহুবচনের মতো দেখালেও এটি একটি বইয়ের নাম। বইয়ের নাম একক বস্তু হিসেবে গণ্য হয়, তাই singular verb ‘is’ বসে।

q: Choose the correct preposition. The police is looking ___ the case.
e: ‘Look into’ মানে কোনো বিষয় তদন্ত বা খতিয়ে দেখা। ‘Look after’ মানে দেখাশোনা করা আর ‘look up’ মানে খুঁজে দেখা, তাই মামলার ক্ষেত্রে ‘look into’ সঠিক।

q: Choose the correct spelling.
e: সঠিক বানান ‘ascertain’, যার অর্থ নিশ্চিতভাবে জেনে নেওয়া। শব্দটিতে ‘a-s-c-e-r-t-a-i-n’ ক্রমে অক্ষর বসে।

q: Select the correct sentence.
o: The man was tall who stole my bag.
The man stole my bag who was tall.
The man who stole my bag was tall.
The man was tall who is stealing tall my bag.
e: Relative clause যে noun-কে ব্যাখ্যা করে, তার ঠিক পরেই বসাতে হয়। তাই ‘The man who stole my bag was tall’ সঠিক, যেখানে ‘who stole my bag’ সরাসরি ‘the man’-এর পরে এসেছে।

q: Complete the sentence with the correct verb from: `Neela _____ her hand when she was cooking dinner’.
e: রান্না করার চলমান কাজের (was cooking) মাঝে হঠাৎ হাত পোড়ার ঘটনা ঘটেছে। চলমান অতীত কাজের মাঝে ঘটে যাওয়া ছোট ঘটনা simple past-এ বসে, তাই ‘burnt’।

q: Choose the correct preposition. The tree has been blown _____ by the storm.
e: ঝড়ে কোনো কিছু উড়িয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়া বোঝাতে ‘blown away’ বলা হয়। ‘Blow up’ মানে বিস্ফোরণে উড়িয়ে দেওয়া, আর ‘blow out’ মানে ফুঁ দিয়ে নেভানো।

q: Identify the correct passive form of `He is going to open a shop.’
o: He is being gone to open a shop
A shop is being gone opened by him
A shop will be opened by him
A shop is going to be opened by him
e: ‘Be going to’ গঠনের passive হয় ‘be going to be + past participle’। তাই ‘A shop is going to be opened by him’ সঠিক।

q: Identify the correct synonym for the word `Magnanimous’.
e: ‘Magnanimous’ মানে উদার ও মহানুভব, যে অন্যের দোষ সহজে ক্ষমা করে। তাই এর সমার্থক ‘generous’।

q: Fill in the blank with the correct phrase: _________ your shoes before entering the mosque.
e: জুতা বা কাপড় খুলে ফেলা বোঝাতে ‘put off’ (বা take off) বলা হয়। ‘Put on’ মানে পরা, তাই মসজিদে ঢোকার আগে জুতা খোলার ক্ষেত্রে ‘put off’।

q: Fill in the blank with the correct phrase: He_____ arrested if he had tried to leave the country.
e: If clause-এ past perfect (had tried) থাকায় এটি third conditional, যা অতীতের অবাস্তব শর্ত বোঝায়। এই গঠনে মূল clause-এ ‘would have + past participle’ বসে; passive বলে ‘would have been arrested’।

q: Choose the right word to fill the blank: Two of the children have to sleep in one bed, but the other three have____ ones.
e: দুই শিশু একই বিছানায় ঘুমায়, কিন্তু বাকি তিনজনের প্রত্যেকের আলাদা বিছানা আছে। আলাদা বা পৃথক বোঝাতে ‘separate’ বসে; ‘different’ মানে ভিন্ন ধরনের।

q: Choose the right word to fill the blank: The Democratic party’s candidate _____ defeat in the small hours of the morning.
e: নির্বাচনে পরাজয় মেনে নেওয়া বোঝাতে ইংরেজিতে ‘accept defeat’ (বা concede defeat) বলা হয়। ‘Agree’ বা ‘consent’ সরাসরি ‘defeat’-এর সঙ্গে বসে না।

q: The proper function of the press is surely to_____ the man in the street with facts.
e: ‘Provide someone with something’ মানে কাউকে কিছু সরবরাহ করা। সংবাদপত্রের কাজ সাধারণ মানুষকে তথ্য সরবরাহ করা, তাই ‘provide the man in the street with facts’।

q: Choose the right word to fill the blank: Since his retirement, Mr. Chowdhury, who was a teacher, ____ has written four novels.
e: অবসরের পর থেকে এ পর্যন্ত চারটি উপন্যাস লেখা হয়ে গেছে, এটি present perfect-এর সঙ্গে ‘already’ দিয়ে বোঝানো হয়। ‘Formerly’ মানে আগে, যা ‘was a teacher’ অংশের সঙ্গে মিলতে পারত, কিন্তু শূন্যস্থানটি ‘has written’-এর আগে।

q: Choose the right word to fill the blank: I should appreciate it if you could complete this work ______ Thursday.
e: কোনো নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে বা তার আগেই কাজ শেষ করা বোঝাতে ‘by’ বসে: ‘by Thursday’। ‘Till’ বা ‘until’ কোনো কাজ চলতে থাকার শেষ সীমা বোঝায়।

q: Choose the right word to fill the blank: It will be your task to make sure the ____ of traffic is maintained without interruption.
e: যানবাহনের নিরবচ্ছিন্ন চলাচল বোঝাতে ‘flow of traffic’ বা ‘traffic flow’ বলা হয়। ‘Current’ সাধারণত পানি বা বিদ্যুতের প্রবাহ বোঝায়।

q: `Pediatric’ relates to the treatment of:
e: ‘Pediatric’ শব্দটি শিশুদের চিকিৎসার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত। শিশুরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞকে বলা হয় pediatrician।

q: The word `ecological’ is related to:-
e: ‘Ecological’ শব্দটি ecology থেকে এসেছে, যা জীব ও তার পরিবেশের পারস্পরিক সম্পর্ক নিয়ে আলোচনা করে। তাই শব্দটি পরিবেশ বা environment-এর সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত।

q: The correct spelling is:-
e: সঠিক বানান ‘humorous’, যার অর্থ হাস্যরসাত্মক। ব্রিটিশ বানানে মূল শব্দ ‘humour’ হলেও বিশেষণ রূপে ‘u’ বাদ দিয়ে ‘humorous’ লেখা হয়।

q: A `Pilgrim’ is a person who undertakes a journey to a-
e: Pilgrim হলেন তীর্থযাত্রী, যিনি ধর্মীয় উদ্দেশ্যে কোনো পবিত্র স্থানে ভ্রমণ করেন। যেমন হজযাত্রীরা মক্কার pilgrim।

q: A person who writes about his own life writes -.
e: নিজের জীবনের কথা নিজে লিখলে তাকে autobiography বা আত্মজীবনী বলে। অন্য কারও জীবনী হলো biography, আর diary হলো দৈনন্দিন ঘটনার খাতা।

q: What is the meaning of ‘White Elephant’?
o: A very costly or troublesome possession
e: ‘White elephant’ মানে এমন সম্পত্তি যার রক্ষণাবেক্ষণে অনেক খরচ ও ঝামেলা, কিন্তু উপকার কম। পুরোনো দিনে শ্যামদেশের রাজারা অপছন্দের লোককে সাদা হাতি উপহার দিতেন, যার ভরণপোষণে সে নিঃস্ব হয়ে যেত।

q: If we want concrete proof, we are looking for-.
e: ‘Concrete proof’ মানে স্পষ্ট ও নিশ্চিত প্রমাণ। এখানে ‘concrete’ নির্মাণসামগ্রী অর্থে নয়, বরং বাস্তব ও সুনির্দিষ্ট অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

q: The lights have been blown _____ by the strong wind.
e: বাতাসে আগুন বা বাতি নিভে যাওয়া বোঝাতে ‘blow out’ বসে। তাই ‘The lights have been blown out by the strong wind’।

q: As the sun___, I decided to go out.
e: বাইরে যাওয়ার সিদ্ধান্তটি অতীতে (decided), আর তখন সূর্য আলো দিচ্ছিল, যা একটি চলমান অবস্থা। তাই past continuous ‘was shining’ সঠিক।

q: Maiden speech means ___.
e: ‘Maiden speech’ হলো কারও প্রথম ভাষণ, বিশেষ করে সংসদ সদস্য হিসেবে সংসদে দেওয়া প্রথম বক্তৃতা। ‘Maiden’ শব্দটি এখানে ‘প্রথম’ অর্থে, যেমন maiden voyage মানে প্রথম যাত্রা।

q: ‘Out and out’ means-.
e: ‘Out and out’ মানে পুরোপুরি বা সম্পূর্ণভাবে। যেমন ‘He is an out and out liar’ মানে সে পুরোদস্তুর মিথ্যাবাদী।

q: He divided the money ___ the two children.
e: দুজনের মধ্যে ভাগ বোঝাতে ‘between’ এবং দুইয়ের বেশি জনের মধ্যে ভাগ বোঝাতে ‘among’ বসে। এখানে দুই শিশু, তাই ‘between’।

q: No one can____ that he is clever.
e: ‘Deny’ মানে অস্বীকার করা, তাই ‘No one can deny that he is clever’ মানে কেউ অস্বীকার করতে পারে না যে সে চালাক। ‘Defy’ মানে অমান্য করা, আর ‘denounce’ মানে প্রকাশ্যে নিন্দা করা।

q: He gave up____football when he got married.
e: ‘Give up’ phrasal verb-এর পরে gerund বসে। তাই ‘gave up playing football’ সঠিক।

q: He has been ill ____ Friday last.
e: Present perfect বা perfect continuous-এ নির্দিষ্ট সময় থেকে শুরু হয়ে এখনো চলছে বোঝাতে ‘since’ বসে। ‘Friday last’ একটি নির্দিষ্ট সময়বিন্দু, তাই ‘since’।
